lines: What do you need?
Come in. Are you hurt?
Mind the bottles and tell me what happened.
I have a moment. Speak.
Sit down if you feel unsteady.
You look worried. Start at the beginning.
Hello. Keep clear of the flame.
Did someone send you to me?
If this is urgent, say so plainly.
I was about to clean up. Your timing is good.
Come closer. The light is better here.
Let me put this bottle away first.
Are you here for medicine or advice?
You can talk while I work.
Mind the cat. It guards the empty chair.
Tell me where it hurts.
I hope this is a social visit.
What brings you to the brewing stand?
Give me the short version first.
I am listening.
